name: Kanál Svobodného přístavu: Find and Transcribe Talks
description: Finds talks on Urza and Tereza's YouTube channel Kanál Svobodného přístavu (about 1,000 lectures, studio talks, conference talks and streams; #ne_poslušnosti videos via stoky.urza.cz/nep/) with youtube_find, youtube_catalog refresh and stoky_search, then transcribes and indexes a video or a clip as a background job (transcribe, job_status) so search_quotes finds the exact moment; explains the auto engine order (GPU faster-whisper, YouTube captions, Groq, CPU, OpenAI), which models are only for locating, that billed engines need a yes, and what to do in claude.ai where YouTube blocks downloads. content:
# Kanál Svobodného přístavu: find and transcribe talks

Urza and Tereza's channel `https://www.youtube.com/@kanalsvobodnehopristavu` holds about 1,000 videos: lectures, Studio Svobodného přístavu talks, KSP conference talks and streams. #ne_poslušnosti videos are linked from `https://stoky.urza.cz/nep/`.

## Task
- Topic or URL: {{topic_or_url}}
- Purpose: {{purpose}}
- Engine: {{engine}}
- Clip: {{clip}}

## 1. Find
- `youtube_find(query=<topic in Czech>, limit=10)` ranks videos by title, description and the Stoky post that announced them (which also gives the date); `transcript_hits` shows moments inside videos already transcribed.
- Also `stoky_search(query="Kanál Svobodného přístavu <topic>")`.
- When `catalog_fetched` is old, run `youtube_catalog(refresh=true)` first.
- Answer with the three to five best: title, date, duration, URL, why it matches, transcribed or not.

## 2. Transcribe and index
`transcribe(src=<url>, engine=<engine>, language="cs", clip=<"MM:SS-MM:SS">)` (leave `clip` out for the whole video) returns a job id; poll `job_status(job_id)` every 30 to 60 seconds. The transcript lands in `$LIBERTY_HOME/transcripts/` (.txt with [mm:ss] markers, .srt, .json) and in the index, so `search_quotes(query=…, sources=["youtube"])` finds the exact moment.
- `engine="auto"` order: GPU faster-whisper, YouTube's Czech captions, Groq (free tier), CPU faster-whisper, OpenAI or a compatible endpoint. Captions show where something was said but have no punctuation; `base` and `small` models are for locating only.
- Ask before an engine that bills the user (OpenAI, ElevenLabs Scribe).
- Direct media URLs (#ne_poslušnosti files on nostr.build, 0.5 to 4 GB) with a clip fetch only the minutes needed.

## 3. Without the toolkit
YouTube blocks cloud servers, so nothing can be downloaded from claude.ai. Offer a speech-to-text connector the user has (for example ElevenLabs) on an audio file they provide, or give the exact command to run in Claude Code: `liberty transcribe <url> --clip MM:SS-MM:SS --engine faster-whisper --model large-v3`.

## 4. Report
The videos found, with links; jobs started (ids) and finished; where the transcript is; the matching moments as timestamp links (`&t=<seconds>s`). To quote a moment verbatim, continue with `liberty-ksp-video-quote`.

variables.name: topic_or_url
variables.description: A topic to search for (Czech works best) or a video URL.

variables.name: engine
variables.description: 'auto' (default), or one of captions, faster-whisper, groq, openai, custom.

variables.name: clip
variables.description: A window 'MM:SS-MM:SS', or '-' for the whole video.
